description: Real CircuitHub quotes (assembled on the US Grid line; boards made in the US or overseas) used to calibrate and test `tsci quote estimate --circuithub`. input is what the estimate reads from each board's circuit JSON, or, with inputSource circuithub-bom, what CircuitHub's BOM says (its parts are not used to check part prices); offers are CircuitHub's prices in USD, excluding shipping and tax. Quotes requested on the date in quotedOn; CircuitHub's prices change over time, so refresh them all together.
